SECRET
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
No. S. B. D. 7164 (c)
Date Jan. 17th., 1941.
REPORT
Subject A.J.A. THORBECKE - FORMER NETHERLANDS MINISTER TO CHINA -
ACTIVITIES OF.
Made by J.S.I. MacLachlan Forwarded by J.I. Crawford.

Mr. A.J.A. Thorbecke, former Netherlands Minister
to China, was dismissed from his post and from the
Diplomatic Service in 1935 by order of Queen Wilhelmina
of the Netherlands in connection with a divorce case.
His second wife Mrs. Ellen Thorbecke is a German
by birth. She is an authoress and has recently written
a book, entitled " Shanghai " containing various aspects
on Shanghai life.
Mr. & Mrs. Thorbecke at present reside at 16b Route
Gisi.
Mr. Thorbecke, up to 1939, was in possession of his
Diplomatic Passport which was withdrawn later by the
local Netherlands Consulate-General upon the
instructions of the Netherlands Government. He,
nevertheless, is reported to still, when an opportunity
arises, continues to seek privileges attendant on
Diplomatic rank.
Although he is known to have no permanent
employment or any business, he is reported to be in
comfortable financial circumstances and is very free
with his money.
He travels a lot and most of his trips have been
to North China and Manchukuo where he is reported to
have good connections with Manchukuo Government.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH）
（批：File.）
（印：INDEXED BY (S.B.) REGISTRY DATE 18/1/41）

编号 S. B. D. 7164 (c)
日期 1941年1月17日。
报告
事由 A.J.A. 托尔贝克（A.J.A. THORBECKE）——前荷兰驻中国公使——之活动。
制作人 J.S.I. 麦克拉克伦（J.S.I. MacLachlan） 转呈人 J.I. 克劳福德（J.I. Crawford）。

A.J.A. 托尔贝克先生，前荷兰驻中国公使，因涉及一桩离婚案件，于1935年奉荷兰威廉明娜女王之命被免去职务并退出外交界。
他的第二任妻子埃伦·托尔贝克夫人（Mrs. Ellen Thorbecke）系德国出生。她是一位作家，最近写了一本名为《上海》的书，书中包含关于上海生活的各个方面。
托尔贝克夫妇目前居住在祁齐路（Route Gisi）16b号。
托尔贝克先生直至1939年仍持有其外交护照，该护照后来根据荷兰政府的指示被当地荷兰总领事馆收回。尽管如此，据报他一旦有机会，仍继续寻求与外交级别相关的特权。
虽然已知他没有固定职业或任何生意，但据报他经济状况宽裕，花钱十分大方。
他经常旅行，大部分行程是前往华北和满洲国，据报他与满洲国政府有着良好的关系。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科）
（批：归档。）
（印：由特务科登记室索引 日期 1941年1月18日）

S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D.
1, Special Branch, Stores,
Date March 29, 1939.
Subject W.J.R. THORBECKE - former Minister to China of the
Netherlands - Antecedents and activities
Made by D.S.I. Mac Adie Forwarded by C. Crawford D.I

Mr. W.J.R. THORBECKE was Minister to China
of the Netherlands between 1932 and 1935. In the
latter year he was dismissed from the Diplomatic
Service owing to his being involved in a divorce case.
He is now in the Far East representing a
number of Netherland and European business firms and
maintains an apartment No.A-19 in the Cathay Mansions.
He is actually in Singapore at present but his wife
and children are living at the apartment in question.
The Netherlands Consulate General have
received no official cognizance of his business in
the Far East and it is confidentially learned that
his activities have caused the Consular officials
some embarrassment, due to his continuing to seek
privileges attendant on Diplomatic rank. He has
succeeded in obtaining a Special Licence for his
car from the French Police in the Concession, is
stated to be still using his Diplomatic passport
and to be claiming rebates from shipping companies
etc. usually granted to Diplomats.

R.W. Mac Adie.
D. S. I.

事由 W.J.R. 托尔贝克（W.J.R. THORBECKE）——前荷兰驻中国公使——背景及活动
制作人 副督察长 麦卡迪（Mac Adie） 转呈人 督察长 C. 克劳福德（C. Crawford）

W.J.R. 托尔贝克先生于1932年至1935年间担任荷兰驻中国公使。同年，他因卷入一桩离婚案件而被免去外交职务。
他目前在远东地区代表多家荷兰及欧洲商业公司，并在国泰公寓（Cathay Mansions）保留A-19号公寓。
他本人目前实际上在新加坡，但其妻子和子女居住在该公寓内。
荷兰总领事馆并未正式知悉其在远东的商业活动，且据密悉，由于其继续寻求与外交级别相关的特权，其活动已令领事官员感到些许尴尬。据悉，他已成功从法租界巡捕房为其汽车获得特别执照，据称仍在使用其外交护照，并向轮船公司等索取通常给予外交官的折扣优惠。

R.W. 麦卡迪（Mac Adie）。
